source_errors.IWM: Split events require audited executable price conventions; no fabricated adjustment is used

limitations: Price-only OHLC omits dividends and cash interest; that can alter crossings/stop decisions, not simply subtract income
Current source receipts are retrospective; vendor split-normalized units are not unadjusted historical integer shares
ETF factors overlap previously seen stocks/indexes; no claim of globally independent or blind economic regimes
Month bootstrap is descriptive and source/rule-selection uncertainty remains; positive history does not guarantee future profit
Seven-year or33-month profit is not a fast challenge/payout result; exact equity reset, news and execution are unverified

costs.funding_basis: Previous closed notional for each elapsed UTC calendar date on a carried position, including weekends; debit before next opening exits
costs.price_basis: Original Yahoo OHLC quote; adjclose never used; no dividends credited, no future dividend adjustments fabricated; price-only may change signals, not simply conservatively subtract income
costs.status: Predeclared research assumptions; not verified broker/CFD tariffs

execution.entry_exit: Closed information only; next session open; never same-close signal fill; long/cash only
execution.final_close: Liquidate at final sample close; no opening new positions on final bar
execution.segment_state: Every training, validation, historical and confirmation segment starts flat with independent initial cash; causal indicators may use earlier bars; no trade crosses a boundary
execution.stop: Fixed3*WilderATR14 from last closed decision bar, relative to adverse entry fill; never trailed; no profit target
execution.stops: Opening gap below stop fills at opening; intrabar low<=stop fills stop; indicator exit at opening before later intrabar extremes

inference.trade_count: Aggregate asset trades are descriptive, not20independent portfolio observations
inference.unit: Synchronized aggregate portfolio calendar-month returns, never independently resampled asset trades

protocol.orders: Research and paper planning only; no live orders, broker login, deposit, purchase, payout promise or verified real firm

portfolio.cash_reservation: Equal fixed20% capital buckets, own realized-equity compounding; entry notional plus fee cannot exceed bucket cash equity; no capital transferred between ETFs

qualification.real_prop_fit: Not established: ETF OHLC is not executable firm CFD/futures; overnight/weekend-forbidden products excluded
qualification.risk_matched_benchmark: Baseline scale=training portfolio daily-return volatility / same-five-ETF1x buyhold volatility, cap1; freeze before holdouts; baseline rebought flat each segment

rules.bt_sma_10_30: Daily SMA10/SMA30; enter only previous difference<0 and current difference>0; exit only previous difference>0 and current difference<0; equality breaks a crossover; stop requires a new strict crossover
rules.faber_sma_10m: Only first new calendar-month session open: use previous completed month close and arithmetic mean of its last10 completed month-end closes; >enter,<exit,=hold; after stop re-entry only at next monthly decision
rules.qc_ema_15_30: Daily EMA15/EMA30 seeded with each period's SMA; flat entry fast>slow*1.00015, long exit fast<slow; equality holds; stop permits next fresh daily level re-entry

protocol.scope: This project's ETF inputs are new, but common equity factors overlap past stock/index studies. Historical periods and source authors are not globally blind. No new hypotheses, symbols, dates or thresholds after results.

selection.objective: Aggregate training net_return_pct-0.7*worst_bar_drawdown_pct; exact ties strategy_id lexical; no parameter fit
selection.primary: One family only, across the full fixed five-ETF portfolio; lock before any historical or confirmation performance

sources.verified: Official historical source retrieved by independent source agent; indicator/entry policy only, not a profit claim

sources.source: Backtrader official historical strategy and crossover indicator
sources.verified: Official historical source retrieved; 2015 strict previous-sign crossover, not modern equality memory

sources.source: Meb Faber, A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation (original 2006/2007, mirrored 2013 update)
sources.verified: Paper text read from third-party mirror; author-host integrity not independently verified; paper is not copied or redistributed
